package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"slices"
	"testing"
)

// TestNativeOracle records the pinned implementation's decisions for external comparison.
func TestNativeOracle(t *testing.T) {
	type scenario struct {
		Name     string   `json:"name"`
		Files    []string `json:"files"`
		Labels   []string `json:"labels"`
		Event    string   `json:"event"`
		Draft    bool     `json:"draft"`
		Fork     bool     `json:"fork"`
		Enforced bool     `json:"enforced"`
		Unknown  bool     `json:"unknown"`
	}
	input, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("NATIVE_SCENARIOS"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var scenarios []scenario
	if err := json.Unmarshal(input, &scenarios); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	outcomes := map[string]any{}
	for _, s := range scenarios {
		plan, defaults, err := openDecision("../test-domains.yaml", "../decision-defaults", s.Files, s.Labels, s.Unknown, metadata{})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		jobs := []string{}
		for name, run := range plan.jobs {
			if run {
				jobs = append(jobs, name)
			}
		}
		slices.Sort(jobs)
		uiOnly := len(s.Files) > 0
		for _, path := range s.Files {
			uiOnly = uiOnly && len(path) >= 3 && path[:3] == "ui/"
		}
		dispatch := dispatchPlan(dispatchInput{pullRequest: s.Event == "pull_request", fork: s.Fork, draft: s.Draft, uiOnly: uiOnly, enforce: s.Enforced, labels: s.Labels}, &plan, defaults)
		outcomes[s.Name] = map[string]any{"selected": jobs, "dispatch": dispatch}
	}
	output, err := json.MarshalIndent(outcomes, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("NATIVE_EXPECTED"), append(output, '\n'), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
